resources.string: Optional extras served by Aura\'s own server: remote switches, notices and one-tap diagnostics. Everything here is off until an address is set, and you can switch it off at any time.
Master switch. Off = the app never contacts the server.
The address of Aura\'s edge Worker. Leave blank to keep the services off.
Not set (nothing the server says is trusted)
Public key that proves a message really comes from Aura\'s server.
Could not check (the app keeps working as usual)
Uploads the same log you would share by hand and gives you a short code to hand over. Only when you press it.
Set the server address in Settings ▸ Aura services first
Use Aura\'s own rooms: faster and private, but only with other Aura users. Off keeps the shared server that other apps also use.
Battery optimisation can stop this device from playing when an order arrives from your other device with the screen off. Tap to remove it for Aura.
